candidates.title: Will Ben Shelton win at least 3.5 more games than Luca Van Assche?

The following market refers to the Luca Van Assche vs Ben Shelton professional tennis match in the 2026 ATP Paris Semi Finals. candidates.title: Michael Wilson Receptions Ladder
candidates.rules_primary: If Each Yes contract pays $0.05 per reception recorded by Michael Wilson during the Arizona vs Seattle Pro Football game originally scheduled for Nov 8, 2026. Each No contract pays $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Yes pays out at most $1.00. Then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
This is a scalar market. The Yes payout per contract is $0.05 per reception constrained between $0.00–$1.00 with a cap at 20 receptions. The No payout is $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Payouts are proportional to the size of the holder's position. For example, 8 receptions pays Yes $0.40 and No $0.60; 11 receptions pays Yes $0.55 and No $0.45; zero receptions pay Yes $0.00 and No $1.00.
